name: Midheaven Development
description: Defines Midheaven expression across universal developmental stages without converting actualization into achievement guarantees.

content.coreRule: Development changes the coherence, responsibility, and integration of public actualization; it does not change the Midheaven's identity as a reference frame.

functionalPattern: Seeks visible direction through external expectations
Uses public feedback as a broad identity verdict
learningTaskComponents: Identify the private foundation supporting the role

functionalPattern: Uses status to compensate for insecurity
requiredConditions: explicit status, shame, exposure, or authority evidence

functionalPattern: Learns to distinguish recognition from function
learningTaskComponents: Balance public effort with private restoration

functionalPattern: Brings capacities into observable and accountable participation
Uses feedback without collapsing identity into reputation
Coordinates public role with private foundation
Allows actualization to evolve without identity collapse
eligibleVerbs: coordinate Midheaven and Imum Coeli frames
requiredConditions: sustained balance between visibility, responsibility, and private grounding
developmentalContribution: Makes capacities socially usable without reducing identity to role
Supports visible responsibility without status inflation
Coordinates public contribution and private restoration
Allows recognition to remain secondary to function

crossStageRules.rule: The same actualization domain may use different surface verbs at different stages.
Status-seeking, visibility avoidance, and role overidentification require explicit defensive evidence.
Integrated Midheaven expression may still include ambition, visibility, and authority.
Healthy actualization does not guarantee fame, wealth, or recognition.
No stage may introduce a semantic domain absent from approved Midheaven vocabulary.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Reference-frame vocabulary only. Psychology and development qualify public actualization but do not redefine the Midheaven as career, status, fame, or guaranteed achievement.
